rules.statement: Don't report that a test runs its own literal copy of a command or wrapper instead of the shipped one when another test already requires that exact string, verbatim, in every shipped copy.
rules.why: The verbatim text check ties the shipped copies to the tested string, so a shipped copy can't drift from the one the test runs without the test suite failing.
rules.check: Before raising the finding, search the test suite for a text assertion that requires the tested string verbatim in each shipped file; report only if no such assertion exists or it matches only a fragment.

rules.statement: Don't ask for a content check to loop over every generated or templated file when the content comes from one shared partial that all of them include, a sample of files confirms the include, and a generated-files check catches any file that drifts from its template.
rules.why: The shared partial is the single source of the wording, so checking a sample proves the include, and the generated-files check already catches a file that drifts from its template.
rules.check: Before reporting incomplete coverage of templated files, look at whether the content comes from a shared partial and whether a generated-files or drift check compares the outputs with their templates.
